candidates: When counting substring occurrences using `string.split(substring).length - 1`, always wrap the result with `Math.max(0, …)`. `''.split('')` returns an empty array (length `0`), not length `1`, so the unguarded expression produces a negative count for empty-string inputs.

All exported functions should have a TSDoc block comment, even for simple or self-explanatory utilities. Exported symbols are part of the module's public API and callers may not have access to the source (especially in minified builds); at minimum include a one-line description and `@param`/`@returns` tags. The project may enforce this in the future via an ESLint rule such as `"jsdoc/require-jsdoc": ["warn", {"publicOnly": true}]`.
